name: UDO Super 8
description: UDO Super 8 polysynth: every parameter of its manual's MIDI specifications, as its 14-bit NRPN where it has one, as its controller where not.

sources.title: UDO Super Gemini & Super 8 Owner's Manual
sources.notes: MIDI specifications, continuous controllers and NRPNs (PDF pages 116 - 128), read by tools/profiles/udo/import-udo.mjs from 66e3ffcd302ab7007da33da0_UDO_SuperGemini-Super8_Manual.pdf (sha256 1af040883c1fe2689184b8fbc8e36ea82b0d3a92cbf6ae4c9b23f4c9a2e337a6), https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/641dd1a703957e750da6b5e3/66e3ffcd302ab7007da33da0_UDO_SuperGemini-Super8_Manual.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/udo/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/udo/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN table (sent as that NRPN, 14 bits) or, where it has none, of its continuous controller table (sent as that controller, with the values it prints). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The instrument's TX/RX setting must have MIDI CC Receive on; the manual: with it on, it "will always respond to both parameter changes sent in 7 and 14 bit resolution".

Parameters both tables give, laid out as the NRPN (14 bits): Tempo (CC 3, NRPN 1027), Portamento Time (CC 5, NRPN 1029), VCA Envelope Level (CC 7, NRPN 1031), Mod Amount/Fine Adjust (CC 9, NRPN 1033), Pan (CC 10, NRPN 1034), Delay Time (CC 12, NRPN 1036), Delay Feedback (CC 13, NRPN 1037), LFO 1 Rate (CC 17, NRPN 1041), LFO 1 Delay (CC 18, NRPN 1042), DDS LFO 1 Amount (CC 21, NRPN 1045), DDS Envelope 1 Amount (CC 22, NRPN 1046), PW/Detune (CC 25, NRPN 1049), PWM/Wave Modulation (CC 26, NRPN 1050), Cross Modulation (CC 28, NRPN 1052), Envelope 1 Decay Hold (CC 32, NRPN 1056), Envelope 2 Decay Hold (CC 33, NRPN 1057), DDS 2 Tune (CC 35, NRPN 1059), Oscillator Mix (CC 37, NRPN 1061), VCA LFO 2 Amount (CC 42, NRPN 1066), VCF Envelope Amount (CC 45, NRPN 1069), VCF LFO 1 Amount (CC 46, NRPN 1070), VCF DDS 2 Amount (CC 47, NRPN 1071), Envelope 1 Attack Hold (CC 52, NRPN 1076), Envelope 1 Attack (CC 53, NRPN 1077), Envelope 1 Decay (CC 54, NRPN 1078), Envelope 1 Sustain (CC 55, NRPN 1079), Envelope 1 Release (CC 56, NRPN 1080), Envelope 2 Decay (CC 57, NRPN 1081), Envelope 2 Sustain (CC 58, NRPN 1082), LFO 2 Rate (CC 62, NRPN 1086), LFO 2 Delay (CC 63, NRPN 1087), DDS LFO 2 Amount (CC 70, NRPN 1094), VCF Resonance (CC 71, NRPN 1095), Envelope 2 Release (CC 72, NRPN 1096), Envelope 2 Attack (CC 73, NRPN 1097), VCF Cutoff Frequency (CC 74, NRPN 1098), VCF LFO 2 Amount (CC 75, NRPN 1099), DDS Pitch Bend Amount (CC 76, NRPN 1100), VCF Pitch Bend Amount (CC 77, NRPN 1101), Delay Send (CC 91, NRPN 1115), VCA LFO 1 Amount (CC 92, NRPN 1116), Drift (CC 94, NRPN 1118), HPF Cutoff Frequency (CC 95, NRPN 1119), Layer Detune (CC 108, NRPN 1132), VCA DDS 2 Amount (CC 109, NRPN 1133), LFO 2 Rate Modulation (CC 110, NRPN 1134), Performance Detune (Super 8: Receive only) (CC 111, NRPN 1135).

Left out, the lever and wheel, the ribbon, the pedals, bank select, data entry, the NRPN and RPN controllers and the channel mode messages: NRPN 1025 Modulation Lever, NRPN 1035 Expression, CC 0 Bank Select, CC 1 Modulation Lever, CC 2 Ribbon Coarse, CC 4 Foot Controller, CC 6 Data Entry MSB, CC 11 Expression, CC 34 Ribbon Fine, CC 38 LSB for Control 6 (Data Entry), CC 64 Sustain Pedal, CC 96 Data Increment, CC 97 Data Decrement, CC 98 Non-Registered Parameter Number (NRPN) - LSB, CC 99 Non-Registered Parameter Number (NRPN) - MSB, CC 100 Registered Parameter Number (RPN) - LSB, CC 101 Registered Parameter Number (RPN) - MSB, CC 120 All Sound Off, CC 121 Reset All Controllers, CC 122 Local Control On/Off, CC 123 All Notes Off, CC 124 Omni Mode Off, CC 125 Omni Mode On, CC 126 Mono Mode On, CC 127 Poly Mode On.
